system.description:
Rangers who hunt one kind of prey above all others: the Waste-watchers of Treaty Hold and the Wardens of the Wilds, the fiend-hunters of Ordenvael, the tide-hunters of the Jinia coasts, and bounty hunters who take monster contracts.

  • Chosen Quarry: choose Beast (beasts, magical beasts and monstrosities), Fiend (your weapons also count as magical against fiends), Tide (creatures with a swim speed), Undead, or Waste (the beasts and raiders of the Red Waste), or another the GM allows. Your Hunter's Edge applies to your quarry in full, as it does to your marked prey.
    • 9th level: your weapon hits against your quarry ignore its resistances.
  • Hunter's Eye: Advantage on checks to track, identify, or learn the habits and weaknesses of your quarry.
